verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own docs show that accountants can bulk add or edit the Chart of Accounts by CSV upload from Company Settings, and that Classes support unlimited Groups, which covers class dimensions. The evidence never mentions setting account types, creating sub-account hierarchies, or editing individual accounts in the UI. missing for 10: documented account-type configuration, sub-account/parent-child hierarchy support, tag dimensions beyond classes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can customize the chart of accounts with account types, sub-accounts, and class or tag dimensions

citations.quote: If you need to bulk add or edit your Chart of Accounts in Puzzle, you can do so by uploading a CSV file directly from your Company Settings.
a user can create an unlimited number of Groups for Classes
